timeline.summary: Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹330.35 Cr (-2.7% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹17 Cr (-18.2% YoY).
NOCIL filed its investor presentation for Q4 and FY26 on May 7, 2026.
NOCIL Limited’s **Amit K. Vyas** (Head-Legal & Company Secretary) uploaded the audio recording of the Q1FY26/Annual Investor Conference Call on the company’s website on 8 May 2026.
NOCIL reported Q4 FY26 revenue of ₹330 Cr with EBITDA margin at 6.4%, and guided for double-digit volume growth in FY27.
NOCIL filed the annual promoter share encumbrance disclosure under Regulation 31(4) of SEBI SAST Regulations for the year ended March 31, 2026.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹426.89 Cr (+33.2% YoY), net profit ₹24.05 Cr (+98.4% YoY).
NOCIL Limited uploaded audio recording of investor conference call on 30th October 2026.
